The team, led by second year head coach [[Mark Turgeon]], played their home games at the [[Comcast Center (arena)|Comcast Center]]. They finished the season 25–13, 8–10 in ACC play to finish in seventh place. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2013 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] where they lost to North Carolina.
